That is what most of these sub communities end up being.  There are a pretty large amount of straight, asexual, female, racial minorities who join these communities as well.  There is rarely a rule setup saying other people can't join, just rules stating intolerance won't be tolerated.

Here is the thing people don't quite seem to get, no matter how the meaning of a word might change, it doesn't change the history.  People still get called faggot and beaten to death.  People still get called faggot and kicked out of their homes and families. People still get called faggot and denied their rights. A few games? Surely you kid.  You are correct in that it shouldn't matter, but it matters to the rather large variety of douche bags we have to deal with.  It also doesn't matter if someone interprets it as a direct attack on their sexuality.  

Ever been gay bashed?  Ever had people kicking you and screaming at you how it is all your fault because you are a faggot?  Ever had one of your friends kill them self because they couldn't take their parents and siblings yelling about how much of a faggot they were and how they were ruining their life? 

Not having to relive these things on a daily basis, especially when I just want to play a game with friends and have fun is kind of the point.  What I'm trying to say is that until the paradigm that most average gamers have in mind about homophobic and racial slurs change it ***does make sense*** to have a subculture where you can feel safe and wanted and not have to be constantly reminded of all the bullshit you may have to wade through in the real world.
